source.title: Ulster Herald, 31 May 1958, p. 5 ("Notice of Result of Election: Rural District of Clogher, 1958")
source.publisher: Ulster Herald (via the Irish Newspaper Archives)
source.check: Returning Officer's Notice of Result, dated 21 May 1958 (Ulster Herald, 31 May 1958, p. 5): the name is entered in column 6 for this division, no poll being needed; read from the INA OCR, where columns 2, 3 and 6 each list the sixteen names in division order and agree

note: Triennial election of the rural district councillors, polled Thursday 5 June 1958. No Clogher division was contested; all sixteen members are recorded from the Returning Officer's Notice of Result, dated 21 May 1958 (Ulster Herald, 31 May 1958, p. 5), read from the page OCR. No labels are printed. Returned unopposed.
